label: resilient spirit
text: A resilient spirit uses hope, meaning, and emotional clarity to move through pain without numbing both hurt and joy. Readers can distinguish relief that restores agency from numbing that quietly reduces aliveness.

label: Index Card Route / Gala Message Audit
text: Index Card Route / Gala Message Audit gives the research spine for a middle-school counseling office scene, using goals, pathways, hope as concrete handles. The pressure point is a discouraged student leaving with only a pep talk. Hope becomes trainable when it leaves the poster and becomes a route. The student can test agency through a next step, not a mood.

label: Clinic Purpose Call
text: Clinic Purpose Call gives the research spine for a community clinic budget meeting scene, using clinic, purpose, call as concrete handles. The pressure point is staff giving up after a grant cut. Purpose keeps power from becoming control. The clinic can face limits without acting as if no meaningful change remains.

label: Cart Before Checkout / Phone Off After Bedtime
text: Cart Before Checkout / Phone Off After Bedtime gives the research spine for a late-night online shopping scene, using already, numbing, pain as concrete handles. The pressure point is relief that dulls the next morning. The pause does not shame pleasure. It separates real need from escape, so relief does not quietly shrink the whole emotional range.

label: Julia should ask one teammate for a review slot and name the task she still believes she can handle.
text: Julia should ask one teammate for a review slot and name the task she still believes she can handle. Because Resilience includes help-seeking, social support, and belief in coping.
